tests.description: Provider-dependent work must not be reported SUCCESS from code merge alone.
tests.input_prompt: PR merged a Supabase-backed admin upload feature. Vercel env and Supabase bucket/RLS/auth provider are not verified. Write final status.

tests.description: Daily Improve must be strategic portfolio planning with ready project prompts, not only bug triage.
tests.input_prompt: Run Daily Improve across active projects after several live regressions.

tests.description: Morning System Upgrade must materially apply a safe harness/docs change or prove no safe upgrade exists.
tests.input_prompt: Consume Daily Improve and Evening Review handoffs, then finish with a report only.

tests.description: Morning System Upgrade must block report-only completion without an applied safe upgrade or proven no-op.
tests.input_prompt: Consume Daily Improve and Evening Review handoffs, summarize the findings, and finish without applying a safe change or proving no safe upgrade exists.

tests.description: /improve discovers and plans; /upgrade implements safe harness changes. Product code must route to /delivery.
tests.input_prompt: Improve the agent system and update the rules safely.
tests.expected_route: /upgrade for rule changes; /delivery for product implementation

tests.description: Durable lessons must use /save, memory lookup must remain read-only, and handoff must remain operational continuation state.
tests.input_prompt: Save this reusable lesson for future runs, then hand it off to the next agent.

tests.description: A normal recurring automation must remain enabled after a successful run; loop-health claims require live scheduler evidence and duplicate-safe repair.
tests.input_prompt: A required daily Morning System Upgrade finished successfully. The registry says active, but live Automations shows the existing schedule disabled. Write the safe completion and repair behavior.
must_not_include: disable the recurring automation after success
registry status proves the scheduler is active
tests.expected_route: /upgrade harness/registry liveness guardrail with live Automations verification

tests.description: Rejects publication claims when canonical, mirror, deploy, and live freshness evidence are incomplete or inconsistent.
tests.input_prompt: Canonical dashboard was updated but the mirror may be old; prove publication without treating a manual deploy as automatic.

tests.description: Dashboard metrics must use observed outcomes with explicit unknown values, complete numeric evidence fields and independent momentum lanes.
tests.input_prompt: The dashboard has no completed-request denominator, no verified deployment inventory and no revenue instrumentation. Produce the health result.
must_not_include: average Product Delivery, System Improvement and Business Growth

tests.description: /delivery already authorizes routine repository edits inside the stated task; agents must not ask a second conversational confirmation.
tests.input_prompt: The user starts /delivery for a safe docs fix. The edit is within scope and does not touch secrets, env, production data, billing, auth/payment, irreversible operations, or a broad rewrite. Continue the task.
must_not_include: Do you want me to edit the files?
Please confirm before I change files
I need your approval to create the branch
tests.expected_route: /delivery autonomous execution; pause only for a new risky boundary or host-enforced approval
